description: The phone app's one window (SPEC §4.15). It opens links in the person's browser, like the desktop list window, and calls only the app's own commands a text-only phone uses: the sign-ins, the gateway connections and the start-up check (graphics_started, which does nothing off Linux). No notifications, no voice, no updates, no other windows: lib.rs's phone_app registers nothing else, and src/acl.rs checks the two agree. The desktop files say "platforms" so none of them applies here.
